NFC Smart Cards

New

One tap replaces a business card, a QR code, and a search bar. People land straight on a page built entirely around your brand — no typing, no searching, no app.

For Restaurants & Cafés
  • A landing page designed around your place — your colors, your mood, your personality, styled exactly the way you want it
  • Instagram — one tap, zero searching for your handle
  • Location — instant directions straight to your door
  • Google Reviews — one tap to leave a review while the visit is still fresh
  • Facebook Page — one tap away
  • A private feedback line — an unhappy guest messages you directly instead of writing a public review
For Individuals
  • A slim NFC sticker that sits neatly on your phone case
  • One tap shares every account and number you want people to have — instantly
  • Built for anyone who meets new people often and is tired of saying "just search my name"

Every card also carries a backup QR code, so it works even for the one guest whose phone doesn't support NFC — nobody's left out.
